description: rnews_config.rs:87-258 — build_store_for_rnews is a near-verbatim copy of peering/pipeline.rs:241-408 (build_store). Every new backend arm must be added in two places. The copy in rnews_config.rs already diverges slightly (different error text for PgBlob). When a new BackendType variant is added to pipeline.rs, the rnews copy will silently skip it, causing a runtime error or a compile-time non-exhaustive match warning that may go unnoticed. Better approach: refactor build_store to accept a BackendConfig option + fallback IpfsConfig directly, so both callers share one implementation. The RnewsConfig -> StoreBuildResult plumbing becomes a two-line wrapper.
title: build_store duplicated in rnews_config vs pipeline
